paper.title: NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Qiao Gao, Yang Huang, Enze Hou, Yuzhi Liu, Jingrun Chen, Han Wang

issues: This v2 reconstruction replaces the v1 file and reconciles matched/unmatched rows at one version. Revised source tables, LiCN values, NH3 uncertainty, ablation names and standard-error definition are used. Exact released geometries are used; unmatched higher-precision/converted-coordinate instances are retained in proposals for curator resolution, not silently forced into rounded registry entries.

S4 literature comparisons, MAEs and other energy differences excluded. S10/S11 duplicate S15/S16; only one estimate per model/geometry is retained, preferring S16 for R=1.6. All variants are the source-presented results, not arbitrary optimization checkpoints.

results.system_description: methylamine: 3D isolated all-electron Born-Oppenheimer Coulomb Hamiltonian with clamped nuclei, kinetic -1/2 sum laplacian, electron-electron and electron-nucleus Coulomb terms and nuclear repulsion, atomic units; N_up=9, N_down=9, charge=0; no pseudopotential, no relativistic terms. Nuclei in bohr: Z=6 at (0.0977, 1.3311, 0); Z=7 at (0.0977, -1.4354, 0); Z=1 at (-1.7796, 2.2227, 0); Z=1 at (-0.8659, -2.0776, 1.5352); Z=1 at (-0.8659, -2.0776, -1.5352); Z=1 at (1.1202, 1.9969, 1.6643); Z=1 at (1.1202, 1.9969, -1.6643). Total energy in Ha.
results.variant: Single geometry; electron-nucleus backbone, shared envelope; h1=64, h2=16
results.source_location: Supplementary Table S4, methylamine NucleoNet column; HTML as1_S3.T4; Supplement II.5
results.eligibility_evidence: Original expectation energy of the explicitly represented determinant neural wavefunction, evaluated after optimization with parameters fixed. Supplement I and II.5 define parentheses as autocorrelation-corrected standard errors. Released evaluation code computes unmodified local energies with separate fresh chains, does not update parameters and does not clip; input files set nan_safe=false.
